title: Community Flow registry - public GitHub repo where developers submit Flows for review

summary: Fabio answered all four blocking decisions: repo MadPonyInteractive/cubric-flows-registry (public, go given), MIT licence, PR-for-both-lanes catalogue submission shape (paid lane = metadata + SHA256, package stays private). maturity needs-decision -> planned.

plan.md attached (compact plan, 5 items). Planning proved three things on disk: the linter runs from a BARE checkout with no npm ci; compat.minAppVersion is checked against the pinned checkout's APP_VERSION (head-swap needs 2.0.0, master is 1.6.1); and no released tag carries the linter, so the CI pin starts at master and flips at 2.0. CI therefore runs the engine-free validator only - COMFY_PATH is unreachable on a runner.

checklist.md, validation.md and files.json created at todo -> doing. Compact plan, so one stable checklist step (Implementation); per-item progress lives in plan.md. Ownership derived from the paths plan.md names inside THIS repo - the build itself lands in a scratch dir and a NEW GitHub repo, so the list is deliberately short: .agents/mpi-kanban/tasks/MPI-799/** and docs/flow-packages.md.

Items 1-4 built and verified. MadPonyInteractive/cubric-flows-registry EXISTS, PRIVATE, main, 8 files. CI proven on a real runner across three probe runs, and the probe earned itself: a git pathspec * crosses / , so flows/*.json also ate the package's own flow.json/workflow.json - the first free-lane PR would have gone red with 14 nonsense errors while the package linter never ran. Fixed with :(glob) in 77acac7 and cherry-picked to main. Zero npm install in either repo, as designed. Remaining: item 5, the public flip - Fabio's call. Plus the still-unnamed paid-lane email, a release-day blocker.
